description: Red Shambhala is a meme aesthetic that emerged on TikTok and Instagram in 2025, pairing Soviet and communist iconography with imagery drawn from Tibetan Buddhist mythology and early-twentieth-century Theosophist esotericism. It is largely a left-wing counterpart to the pre-existing Agartha and Vril trend popular among far-right TikTok editors, recurringly featuring a wheel of sickles that directly parodies the neo-Nazi Black Sun symbol used in Agartha content.
